title: Build the 1.6.3 hand-delivered Windows delta (1.6.2 -> master), never published
description: Stamp master 1.6.3 and build a Windows update-only delta over the tester's 1.6.2 install from the detached worktree D:/tmp/cv-720. Carries the landing big-photo freeze fix (MPI-963) and cloud-only project open (MPI-856), both found in 1.6.2 on 2026-10-01. No tag, no GitHub Release, no manifest publish. Same shape as MPI-938.
